snippet.title: Forestrike | Gameplay Overview | The Fight Starts November 17
snippet.description:
Forestrike launches November 17 on PC and Nintendo Switch. Watch the new gameplay trailer and play the new updated Forestrike Demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2325930/Forestrike_Demo/

A new gameplay trailer offers a deeper look at Forestrike’s expansive world, its unique roguelite systems, and the mysterious story that awaits players. 

The updated demo now includes three out of five schools of combat and new locations for players to sample ahead of the game’s launch. By having access to three schools, players can now unlock new combined abilities and skills. 

Forestrike is a martial arts roguelite where every death brings you closer to winning the fight before it begins. Use your ‘Foresight’ ability to experiment without consequences before fighting for real until earning the ultimate reward - victory without ‘Foresight’.

Win the fight before it begins.

Visit our website for more info: https://www.devolverdigital.com/
